name: Vendor
description: A vendor — a person or business from whom the company purchases products or services.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default. System-assigned; read-only and required for update/delete (passed via the path, not the body).

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required in the body for update to guard against concurrent modification; system-maintained and read-only on create.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: The name of the vendor as displayed. Must be unique across all Customer, Vendor, and Employee objects. At least one of DisplayName, Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix is required on create. Max 500 characters.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Title of the person. Used in conjunction with the name fields. Max 16 characters. One of Title/GivenName/MiddleName/FamilyName/Suffix/DisplayName is required on create.

fields.name: GivenName
fields.description: Given (first) name of the vendor contact person. Max 100 characters. One of Title/GivenName/MiddleName/FamilyName/Suffix/DisplayName is required on create.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the vendor contact person. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: FamilyName
fields.description: Family (last) name of the vendor contact person. Max 100 characters. One of Title/GivenName/MiddleName/FamilyName/Suffix/DisplayName is required on create.

fields.name: Suffix
fields.description: Suffix of the name of the vendor contact person. Max 16 characters.

fields.name: CompanyName
fields.description: The name of the company associated with the vendor. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: PrintOnCheckName
fields.description: Name of the vendor as printed on a check. If not provided, defaults to DisplayName. Max 110 characters.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: If true, this entity is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks. Defaults to true. Setting to false soft-deletes the vendor.

fields.name: PrimaryEmailAddr
fields.description: Primary email address of the vendor.

attributes.name: Address
attributes.description: An email address. Must be a valid email format. Max 100 characters.

fields.name: PrimaryPhone
fields.description: Primary phone number of the vendor.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Max 30 characters (21 for some locales).

fields.name: Mobile
fields.description: Mobile phone number of the vendor.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: Fax
fields.description: Fax number of the vendor.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Max 30 characters.

fields.name: WebAddr
fields.description: Website address of the vendor.

attributes.name: URI
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier for the website. Must be a valid URI. Max 1000 characters.

fields.name: BillAddr
fields.description: Default billing (mailing) address of the vendor (PhysicalAddress).

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the address object, system-assigned.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line3
attributes.description: Third line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line4
attributes.description: Fourth line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line5
attributes.description: Fifth line of the address. Max 500 characters.

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: City name. Max 255 characters.

attributes.name: Country
attributes.description: Country name. Max 255 characters.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, e.g. state in the USA or province in Canada. Max 255 characters.

attributes.name: PostalCode
attributes.description: Postal/ZIP code. Max 30 characters.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geocoded address. System-computed.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geocoded address. System-computed.

fields.name: TaxIdentifier
fields.description: The tax ID of the vendor (e.g. EIN or SSN for 1099 reporting in the US). Returned masked on read for some configurations.

fields.name: AcctNum
fields.description: Name or number of the account associated with this vendor (your company's account number with the vendor). Max 100 characters. Supported in minor versions.

fields.name: Vendor1099
fields.description: If true, this vendor is an independent contractor eligible for 1099 reporting (US only). Indicates an eligible vendor for whom 1099 tracking should occur.

fields.name: Balance
fields.description: Specifies the open balance amount or the amount unpaid to the vendor (accounts payable balance). System-computed and read-only.

fields.name: TermRef
fields.description: Reference to a Term (payment terms) associated with this vendor.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Term object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Term object.

fields.name: APAccountRef
fields.description: Reference to the Accounts Payable account associated with this vendor. Available in minor versions; applicable to multi-AP-account configurations.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced AP Account object.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account object.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency in which all amounts on associated transactions are expressed. Settable on create only when multicurrency is enabled; cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. USD, GBP.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name of the currency.

fields.name: GSTRegistrationType
fields.description: GST registration type of the vendor. India locale specific. Indicates the vendor's GST registration status.

fields.name: GSTIN
fields.description: GST identification number of the vendor. India locale specific. Max 15 characters.

fields.name: BusinessNumber
fields.description: Business number / company registration identifier of the vendor. Locale specific (e.g. ABN for AU, BN for CA). Max 20 characters.

fields.name: T4AEligible
fields.description: If true, the vendor is eligible for T4A reporting. Canada locale specific.

fields.name: T5018Eligible
fields.description: If true, the vendor is eligible for T5018 (Statement of Contract Payments) reporting. Canada locale specific.

fields.name: HasTPAR
fields.description: If true, the vendor is included in the Taxable Payments Annual Report (TPAR). Australia locale specific.

fields.name: OtherContactInfo
fields.description: Additional contact information for the vendor, expressed as a typed name/value pair (ContactInfo).

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: The type of contact information, e.g. TelephoneNumber.

attributes.name: Telephone
attributes.description: Telephone number container for the contact info.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: The telephone number in free-form.

fields.name: VendorPaymentBankDetail
fields.description: Bank account details used for electronic vendor payments. Locale specific.

attributes.name: BankAccountName
attributes.description: Name on the vendor's bank account.

attributes.name: BankBranchIdentifier
attributes.description: Bank branch identifier (e.g. BSB, sort code, routing number).

attributes.name: BankAccountNumber
attributes.description: The vendor's bank account number. May be returned masked.

attributes.name: StatementText
attributes.description: Text to appear on the vendor's bank statement for payments.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The domain identifier; constant value 'QBO'. System-assigned, read-only.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Denotes whether the response object represents a sparse (partial) representation. System-set, read-only in responses.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive metadata about the object, system-maintained and read-only.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created, in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
